findings.body:
`subprocess.run` is now invoked with `shell=True` and an f-string that interpolates `upload_dir`, `name`, and `oid` without quoting or escaping. A value such as `name="x.png; id > /tmp/pwned"` (or metacharacters in `upload_dir` / `oid`) is interpreted by the shell, so this becomes remote command execution on the thumbnail host.

Restore the argv-list form (and keep the absolute binary path). ImageMagick 7’s policy/delegate behavior does not require a shell; use `/usr/bin/magick` or `/usr/bin/convert` with a list of arguments instead:

```suggestion
    subprocess.run(
        ["/usr/bin/convert", f"{upload_dir}/{name}", f"/srv/thumbs/{oid}.png"],
        check=True,
    )
```

If the binary was renamed under IM7, swap in `/usr/bin/magick` with the same list style — do not reintroduce `shell=True`.

The command string calls bare `convert` instead of `/usr/bin/convert`. Under `shell=True` the shell resolves this via `PATH`, so a poisoned PATH (or a shadow binary earlier on PATH) can redirect thumbnail processing. Prefer an absolute path to the IM binary in an argv list (`/usr/bin/convert` or `/usr/bin/magick`).

summary:
## Verdict

**Do not merge** — this change introduces a command-injection vulnerability by switching a safe argv-list `subprocess.run` to `shell=True` with unquoted interpolation of `upload_dir`, `name`, and `oid`.

## Why this is blocking

The previous call passed a fixed binary path and two path arguments as a list, so the kernel exec’d ImageMagick with no shell metacharacter interpretation. The new form builds a single shell string:

```python
f"convert {upload_dir}/{name} /srv/thumbs/{oid}.png"
```

Any of those three values can break out of the intended command (`;`, `|`, `$(…)`, backticks, spaces, quotes). The old comment that `name` was validated upstream by `ALLOWED_FILES` was removed; even if that regex still exists elsewhere, `upload_dir` and `oid` are fully interpolated with no guard visible in this module, and filename allowlists often still permit characters that are deadly inside a shell.

Dropping the absolute `/usr/bin/convert` path in favor of bare `convert` under `shell=True` also makes the invocation depend on `PATH` (and shell builtins), which is a weaker posture on a shared runner or upload-processing host.

## ImageMagick 7 note

If IM7 truly needs a different binary or delegate setup, the usual fix is still argv-list form: call `magick` (or `/usr/bin/magick`) with a list of arguments, or set env/`MAGICK_CONFIGURE_PATH` as required. Policy delegates are enforced inside ImageMagick regardless of whether the parent used `shell=True`; shell mode is not required for that.

## Recommendation

**Recommendation:** request-changes

verification.reason: The patch replaces a safe argv-list `subprocess.run` with `shell=True` and an unquoted f-string of `upload_dir`, `name`, and `oid`, enabling shell metacharacter injection/RCE. Base used a list form without a shell; no in-repo validation of those parameters remains.
